verdict.rationale: Anrok ships its own first-party AI, AI Atlas. It answers any sales tax question with the reasoning shown, grounded in the seller's own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. That is not a generic chatbot, and it sits on a product-tax-category taxability engine. missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers cite the jurisdictional rule base or statutes rather than just the seller's data, documented examples of state-taxability or per-invoice explanations, in-depth docs beyond a single marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration.
